description: This file defines utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and storing them in a linked list, including helper methods for validation.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces and adds valid tokens to a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid and adds it to the provided linked list.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Determines whether a token is valid (non-empty).
